tagline.id: Logger arus portabel dengan sensor hall split-core, dalam casing 3D print.
tagline.en: A portable current logger with a split-core hall sensor, in a 3D-printed case.

approach.id: Arus dibaca sensor hall split-core HSTS016L (±15 A) dan ditampilkan di LCD. Semuanya masuk ke casing 3D print dengan tutup LCD dan tutup baterai.
approach.en: Current is read by an HSTS016L split-core hall sensor (±15 A) and shown on an LCD. Everything fits in a 3D-printed case with LCD and battery lids.
